title: yadif_preflight.sh — FFmpeg yadif deinterlace preflight checker
purpose: Reusable shell preflight for FFmpeg yadif deinterlacing. Derives the correct mode, parity and deint flags from user intent, prints the resulting command without running it, and warns on the three documented failure modes: wrong field order (judder), combing from deint=interlaced, and unexpected frame rate from wrong mode.
